primary.label: GNOME: ttf-bitstream-vera 1.10
primary.note: Bitstream gave the Vera fonts to the GNOME Foundation in 2003. This is GNOME's download folder for their last release, 1.10.

primary.label: Android Open Source Project: data/fonts
primary.note: Google stopped listing Droid Sans Mono on Google Fonts in 2017, when the Droid fonts gave way to Noto; Noto Sans Mono is its revised successor. Android still ships Droid Sans Mono as its monospace font, and this folder of Android's source code holds that file, DroidSansMono.ttf, under the Apache License 2.0.

primary.label: The Go Blog: Go fonts
primary.note: The Go project's announcement of its fonts, by Nigel Tao, Chuck Bigelow and Rob Pike. The TrueType files are in the Go image repository (go.googlesource.com/image), in font/gofont/ttfs, under the Go project's BSD-style license.

primary.label: GitHub: dw5/Metropolis (archived mirror)
primary.note: Metropolis has no official download any more: its designer, Chris Simpson, made his repository private in 2020 after a dispute over the name and said anyone may fork it. This is an archived, unchanged copy of his last version.
